dedupe_keys.name: concretexai mechanical and nondestructive concrete tests

description: ConcreteXAI provides strength and nondestructive-test measurements for twelve concrete mixtures from the Universidad Michoacana de San Nicolás de Hidalgo team. The repository describes compressive, tensile and flexural strength, electrical resistivity and ultrasonic pulse velocity. Reported measurement ages run from 3 to 120 days after casting. It lists 4,420 values for compressive strength and the associated nondestructive measures, 3,460 tensile values and 1,760 flexural values. The versioned Zenodo dataset is freely accessible under CC BY 4.0, while GitHub declares MIT. The current GitHub root lists Data.csv and trained-model files, whereas the README names Final_Artificial_Data.csv. The review does not resolve that filename discrepancy or establish whether every reported point represents a distinct physical sample. Calendar coverage and sample-level provenance require checking before calibration. A reviewer-assessed use is estimating material-property relationships or uncertainty inputs for model-opensees. Neither the CSV nor model weights were downloaded, and no predictor was tested.
